basic_info.description: Nestled on the highly sought-after western slope of Bernal Heights, this stunning and meticulously remodeled interior, envisioned by architect Mason Kirby seamlessly blends contemporary design with timeless charm. Recently professionally painted, the refreshed exterior enhances the home's beautiful curb appeal. Spanning two light-filled levels, this 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers a versatile layout ideal for modern living. The upper level features an open-concept living and dining area, wide-plank hardwood floors and skylights that flood the space with natural light. The primary bedroom and a stylish full bath complete this floor. A flex room opens onto the wood deck, an idyllic spot for morning coffee or evening cocktails, with exterior stairs leading down to the multi-level backyards beautifully landscaped retreat with a lush lawn, garden patio, and BBQ-ready dining space. Downstairs, a custom-designed office fosters creativity, while an additional bonus room serves as a media or recreation space. Two sunny, garden-view bedrooms share a spa-like bath with a deep soaking tub. The larger bedroom offers direct backyard access for an ideal way to begin and end each day in bliss! 1-car garage parking with an EV charger, a laundry room, and ample storage. This one has it all!
